audit_scope: Papers I–IV traditional editions; source mechanisms and runtime boundaries, not a proof audit

sources.title: Paper I: Typed operator systems, seed rank, and exact packet coordinates
Paper II: Refinement towers, weighted transfer, and integral separation of operator packets
Paper III: Typed transfer, nonlinear packets, and obstruction theory
Paper IV: Cyclic analytic functions, reciprocal families, and spectral zero data

mechanisms.summary: Typed quivers, paths, parallel linear relations and finite matrix realizations.
boundaries: Finite paths and declared relations are represented; this is not an abstract quotient-path-algebra equivalence prover.

mechanisms.summary: Finite unital matrix algebra generated by supplied operators.
boundaries: Exact SymPy or tolerance-dependent numerical rank; no arbitrary-ring ideal decomposition.

mechanisms.summary: Orbit hulls and finite evaluation maps with relation kernels.
boundaries: The algebra basis/spanning family is supplied to presentation; abstract module relation ideals and completed free modules are not computed.

mechanisms.summary: Seed-rank construction bounds, semisimple multiplicity formula and rational single-operator primary count.
boundaries: Semisimple multiplicities are caller inputs, not discovered module-top data.
No general Jacobson radical, arbitrary division-ring, or arbitrary coefficient-field decomposition solver.

mechanisms.summary: Complete finite idempotent analysis/synthesis, aggregation, tensor and dual packets.
boundaries: Packet idempotents are supplied and checked; existence does not establish discoverability or numerical conditioning.
Hilbert self-adjointness has a distinct certificate.

mechanisms.summary: Countable unconditional packets, dense generation and completed quotient realizations.
boundaries: No generic countable series/completion operator verifies convergence or quotient topology.
Finite matrix identities cannot establish these infinite topological hypotheses.

mechanisms.summary: Exact operator reconstruction, block multiplication, paths, adjoints, tensors and intertwining.
boundaries: Finite packets and matrices; numerical support depends on tolerance and cancellation may make a permitted path sum zero.

mechanisms.summary: Support preorders, reachability, strongly connected components and conditional packet-pure source counts.
boundaries: Source-component counts do not infer edge surjectivity or internal packet generation; these are unchecked assumptions.
Generic minimum seed search is limited to an explicitly bounded standard-basis search.

mechanisms.summary: Intertwiners, packet morphisms and declared invariant subspace/quotient packet descent.
boundaries: Splitting inclusion/left inverse or quotient map/right inverse are supplied and invariance is checked.
Zero packet labels are retained by the current finite API; no automatic invariant quotient discovery.

mechanisms.summary: Preservation-profile and semantic realization criteria.
boundaries: Intertwiners provide finite concrete witnesses, but no universal categorical proof-transport or preservation-profile engine is implemented.

mechanisms.section: §14; elliptic coordinate ring with relation y²=x³−x
mechanisms.summary: Infinite polynomial coordinate-ring realization and exact product law.
boundaries: No dedicated unbounded coordinate-ring object is implemented; finite operator examples alone do not represent this whole module.

mechanisms.summary: Parent/child idempotent refinement, coherent coordinate changes, block aggregation and common commuting refinement.
boundaries: Finite supplied projector families; noncommuting common-refinement inputs are rejected.

mechanisms.summary: Exact residue selectors, nested addresses and coprime CRT factorization.
boundaries: Finite arrays/addresses; arbitrary-ring root-of-unity character identities remain dependent on their stated invertibility/orthogonality data.

mechanisms.summary: Weighted path enumeration and finite-precision or acyclic inverse expansion.
boundaries: Acyclic finite inversion is exact; infinite filtered convergence is external.
Adic validation checks supplied edge weights, while general filtered truncation retains unchecked filtration hypotheses.

mechanisms.summary: Finite graph rational weighted walk series via inverse weighted adjacency.
boundaries: The present helper is scalar-weighted; arbitrary multivariate weights and minimal recurrences are not automatically extracted.

mechanisms.summary: Bézout construction of exact rational spectral packets from supplied complete coprime characteristic factors.
boundaries: Restricted to finite rational matrices and rational monic polynomial factors.
No general DVR, automatic integral resultant certificate, or lattice intersection discovery.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational single-operator primary packet discovery through characteristic factorization.
boundaries: Each irreducible characteristic factor retains its full multiplicity.
Single-operator rational sector only; no arbitrary commutative Hecke-algebra decomposition or global transfer.

mechanisms.summary: Rational projectors in a supplied lattice, split-lattice inclusion and Smith gluing module.
boundaries: Requires a supplied split basis and validates its compatibility; does not discover every lattice intersection basis.
Rational/integers specialization rather than an arbitrary DVR implementation.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational projector denominator weights and output/input precision delays.
boundaries: Prime valuation on rational data; input lattice and actual projector refinement must be valid.

mechanisms.summary: Smith decomposition with transformations, congruence obstructions, solution counts and bounded enumeration.
boundaries: Exact finite integer/rational matrices and prime-power congruences; enumeration has an explicit resource limit.

mechanisms.summary: Power, polynomial, resolvent, exponential and multilevel linear defect identities.
boundaries: Finite matrices are supported; no arbitrary contour-based holomorphic functional calculus integrator or Banach-operator norm proof.

mechanisms.summary: Typed edge/operator words, walk expansions and reachability obstructions.
boundaries: Finite matrix realization can have non-scalar packet fibers; this does not extend the paper finite Lean contract by itself.

mechanisms.summary: Canonical exact coordinate representation of arbitrary supplied maps.
boundaries: Callback consistency and valid finite packet systems are prerequisites; finite point checks do not prove arbitrary function equality.

mechanisms.summary: Chosen finite graph transports, gauge changes, spanning-tree normalization, fundamental holonomy and intertwining.
boundaries: Connected finite graph, one model fiber dimension and invertible edge maps.
Full-GL numerical residuals are coordinate-sensitive; source metrics/unitary or coordinate regimes have distinct checks.

mechanisms.summary: Packet derivatives, reconstruction, Taylor data and packet Faà di Bruno composition.
boundaries: Exact polynomial/SymPy providers or explicitly numerical derivative providers; derivative/Taylor remainder hypotheses are not proved from sampled callbacks.

mechanisms.summary: Ordered polynomial operation trees, packet-labeled sums and structural pruning.
boundaries: Finite tree/leaf/height bounds and declared multilinear operations; general dependent colored operads are not represented as a universal compiler.

mechanisms.summary: Scalar polynomial majorants and Catalan contraction/tail bounds.
boundaries: Declared operation norm bounds support the conditional convergence argument; finite tree sums alone are not a convergence proof.

mechanisms.summary: Finite group-graded packet convolutions, Maurer–Cartan, higher operations and divided squares.
boundaries: Finite grading and supplied operations; a packet residual computation does not establish all differential graded Lie or L-infinity identities/completeness.

mechanisms.summary: Nonlinear coarsening defects and compositional/orbit/fixed-point estimates.
boundaries: Lipschitz bounds and differentiability are declared external data; evaluation certificates are finite tests.

mechanisms.summary: Linear correction equations, cokernel coordinates, kernels and actual correction witnesses.
boundaries: Finite exact SymPy or tolerance-based numerical solver; a valid obstruction-computation certificate may report a nonzero obstruction.

mechanisms.summary: Transport through a commuting correction square and relative fine/coarse obstruction.
boundaries: Square/defect transport exists; a general snake-lemma six-term sequence and connecting-map witness API are absent.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite cochain-map cone with target/source-shift ordering and negative source differential.
boundaries: Common prime-field, bounded finite complexes only.
Existing cohomology APIs expose dimensions; full class representatives and connecting maps are not constructed.

mechanisms.summary: Hilbert cokernel projection, right-inverse contraction correction and Lyapunov–Schmidt reduction.
boundaries: Numerical SVD/iteration and declared analytic bounds; rank stability, closed range and global Lipschitz hypotheses are not inferred by finite tests.

mechanisms.summary: Prime-field linear corrections, finite polynomial/linear prime-power lift trees and filtered one-step obstructions.
boundaries: Explicit finite depth/branch limits; Python-integer products now remain exact before prime-field reduction.

mechanisms.summary: Conditional completion of an infinite compatible filtered branch.
boundaries: Finite terminal branches are verified; separatedness, completeness, continuity and an infinite compatible branch remain externally declared.

mechanisms.summary: Finite filtered cohomology pages, differential ranks and limiting dimension comparison.
boundaries: Finite prime field and finite decreasing filtration; dimension data do not constitute general class representative or filtered-map naturality output.
A native-int overflow that falsely approved a rank-one F0 as full was repaired with Python-int object arrays.

mechanisms.summary: Hidden-variable solve and exact first/second reduced derivative formulas.
boundaries: Finite exact derivative algebra or numerical hidden solve; local implicit-function hypotheses and a global branch are not proved by iteration.

mechanisms.summary: Canonical projector commutator generator, polar direct rotations and mesh-refinement diagnostics.
boundaries: Finite numerical orthogonal families and supplied derivatives; mesh comparisons do not establish operator-norm convergence for arbitrary Banach/Hilbert families.

mechanisms.summary: Residue coefficient packets, numerical root filters and cyclic packet product convolution.
boundaries: Exact finite coefficients versus numerical root averaging; general holomorphic convergence/range-covariance statements are not verified by a finite polynomial check.

mechanisms.summary: Transfer and signed exponential sections, companion shifts, finite fundamental matrices and addition laws.
boundaries: Point evaluation and matrices are numerical; no generic ODE uniqueness or hypergeometric symbolic equivalence prover.

mechanisms.summary: Formal reciprocal parameter coefficients, logarithmic Newton recurrence and additive parameter law.
boundaries: Integers/rational parameters retain exact Fraction arithmetic; complex analytic powers additionally need a zero-free domain and branch choice.

mechanisms.summary: Transfer tangent and exact coefficient sequence; scalar higher Riccati identity.
boundaries: The tangent/derivatives are callable; there is no separate general higher-Riccati symbolic identity certificate.
Numerical evaluation excludes denominator zeros and does not select arbitrary analytic branches.

mechanisms.summary: Residue-section reciprocal powers, Appell polynomials and theta polynomial coupling.
boundaries: Finite coefficient/polynomial output; full formal differential-operator representation on arbitrary polynomial spaces is not a separate engine.

mechanisms.summary: Asymptotic zero seeds, Newton representatives, rotational orbits and leading zero-count model.
boundaries: Certificates report finite residuals/ordering, not root exhaustion or global ray classification.
Leading displacement/error constants and the finite exceptional zero set are not automatically certified.

mechanisms.summary: Finite Hadamard products and reciprocal coefficient reconstruction from supplied zero orbits.
boundaries: Finite partial products/moments do not implement the full canonical product or infinite diagonal Fredholm operator; missing/tail zeros remain external.

mechanisms.summary: Nearest-pole coefficient asymptotics and multiplicity/branch-sensitive leading terms.
boundaries: No general nearest-pole residue/asymptotic expansion API; positive integral reciprocal order and simple nearest-zero hypotheses are substantive.

mechanisms.summary: Zero zeta finite sums versus meromorphic continuation and derivative-weighted entire series.
boundaries: Only finite supplied-zero sums are implemented.
No symmetry-orbit meromorphic continuation, exceptional-zero logarithm ledger, derivative-weighted entire zeta evaluator or tail theorem.
